mandatoryForEveryEpisode.backgroundQueueRoots: Enqueued before the bounded read episode; the episode must create no additional jobs.
mandatoryForEveryEpisode.receiptCustody: One financial receipt and one original-input private reply after commit; neither accepted original data nor metadata may be recomputed on replay.
mandatoryForEveryEpisode.faults: Real targeted disposable SQL triggers; explicitly remove each before retry; never production fault switches.
mandatoryForEveryEpisode.outerWatchdog: Driver setup/source IO/native queue/shutdown and mandatory verifier are bounded; final PASS is not persisted before complete cleanup
mandatoryForEveryEpisode.privateNativeCustody: Same existing work_input_responses owner, default input or objective:<stepUUID> slot, one step-bound receipt, immutable canonical full reply; no manufactured human inputs, second cache or UPDATE privilege
mandatoryForEveryEpisode.nativeSetup: An actual scripted candidate passes the real compiler and admission owner, then a real SQL reservation fault stops it before any native query dispatch. The original root queue delivery and ordinary parent planner attempt are recorded before zero-delta dispatch meters. No read child job, workforce assignment, recovery planner or fabricated plan/receipt is setup.
mandatoryForEveryEpisode.nativeOracles: Independent SQL source snapshot/text/hash and current committed plan/input/node/step/receipt/private JSONB bytes. Real authenticated private HTTP/native replay, current grants and mapped source rights, full nested isolated-clone corruption, model callback/shared projections, original acceptance and all eight meters are separately checked.
mandatoryForEveryEpisode.ancillaryDistinction: Normal canonical-to-HTTP projection is insert-only and not degraded merely because the row deliberately stores no HTTP envelope. The original real ANCILLARY_RESPONSE_FAILURE_REPLAY fault remains required, and a metadata-only existing Work event records that real response-projection failure.

literalOracle.selectedContext: Must not replace the request's exact company or issuer.
literalOracle.namedRevenue: At/for/of/possessive/bare-company forms; Unrelated Holdings never substitutes the tenant binding.
literalOracle.selectors: Explicit CASH/EUR retained; explicit CALENDAR/FISCAL retained and boundedly UNAVAILABLE.
literalOracle.committedReceiptFault: work_events.event_type=query_execution_completed fails after canonical receipt/private reply commit; actual retry without original idempotency key preserves original complete query.
literalOracle.traceFault: instruction_events.phase=verifying failure remains best-effort; first read succeeds.
literalOracle.uncommittedPrivateFault: Private INSERT failure cannot leave succeeded receipt; explicit retry rearms the same receipt.
literalOracle.ancillaryFault: Private INSERT/UPDATE denied only when receipt already succeeded; canonical private insertion happens while running and survives ancillary failure.
literalOracle.sameTimeQuote: Lower UUID carries expired quote, higher UUID current; repeat with freshness reversed; both stale stays STALE; price/session/delay disagreement stays CONFLICTED.
literalOracle.scopedAuthority: Application owner role is not a business wildcard: a separate fixture employee has only real exact-resource financial grants. Test missing/relevant/unrelated deny, active/expired assignment and role/user currentness.
literalOracle.tampering: Actual private JSONB corruptions of metadata, source/meta, page/count/status, IDs, intent/outcome and financial facts must refuse replay; keeping answer.query in sync must not bypass complete validation.

acceptance: All 65 independently observed predicates must PASS. Fixed verifier IDs, actual rows/literals/identities/private bytes, app and worker principals, source/auth/network custody, zero activation, completed bounded shutdown and combined driver/verifier elapsed time are required. Missing, FAIL, NOT_RUN, duplicate IDs, source drift or unknown profile never qualify. SOURCE_V1 is diagnostic only.
installedReviewReadsV2: INSTALLED, including parent corrections; the original 47 remain required
proposalIntegrationScope: Only explicit metadata-only financial canonical-query acceptance on the original native human/input/accepted selected query-and-check-only PlanGraph is supported. General, mixed, fact-dependent or unprovable native financial goals block unchanged; they are not claimed integrated. This isolated source proposal has not been installed or executed.
